'''Annabel Blaine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force Adept]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Blaine was raised by her father, an independent [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who was considered by some to be a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], and as a child she became fascinated with [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] that depicted members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. After her father perished in a skirmish against a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], Blaine joined the Rebel Alliance and sought revenge against the Empire. While among the Rebels, Blaine encountered a number of other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], who trained her to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and under their tutelage, she constructed a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="UCD" />

At some point after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Blaine and a team of Rebel agents were [[Mission to Tazan|dispatched]] by the Alliance to the planet [[Tazan]], to destroy an [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] that was located on the world. After arriving on Tazan, Blaine and the rest of the team rendezvoused with the Alliance sympathizer [[Willer Clines]] in [[Willer Clines' House|Clines' house]], in the [[Desander Section]] of [[Tazan City]]. However, their conversation with Clines was secretly monitored by a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and once the stormtroopers believed that Rebels had revealed all that they would about their mission, the stormtroopers entered Clines' lounge and attacked Blaine and the rest of the Rebels. The agents escaped and eventually infiltrated the Data Processing Facility, where they extracted some Imperial TIE fighter communications protocols and then blew up the structure.<ref name="UCD" />
